NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 30, 10:35 PM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 21.6 DraftKings points for $8,600, against the Chargers. CeeDee Lamb (19.1, $8,100) and Ja'Marr Chase (17.9, $7,700) are next.

Puka Nacua is also the top value at the position: 2.52 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 30, 10:35 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 8

Puka Nacua, LAR vs LAC ($8,600)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.6 DraftKings points at $8,600. That is 2.6 points clear of CeeDee Lamb. The model gives him 10.6 targets on 30.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.52 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 37 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 21.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 47.4, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 45.5.

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs ARI ($8,100)

CeeDee Lamb projects 2nd at the position with 19.1 DraftKings points at $8,100. The model gives him 9.6 targets on 33.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.36 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 37 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 19.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.0 and a ceiling of 44.5, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30.75 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Ja'Marr Chase, CIN vs TEN ($7,700)

Ja'Marr Chase projects 3rd at the position with 17.9 DraftKings points at $7,700. The model gives him 7.4 targets on 30.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.32 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 37 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Chase averaged 18.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.1 and a ceiling of 43.2, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 12.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Keenan Allen, IND at JAX ($4,500)

Keenan Allen projects for 10.8 DraftKings points at $4,500, which works out to 2.40 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 37 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 6.9 targets on 25.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 10.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.8 and a ceiling of 26.3, and he holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Indianapolis is a 10-point underdog on the road against Jacksonville, with an implied team total of 18.25 in a game totaled at 46.5.
